housing.summary: Dublin's rental market is tight and expensive, with strong demand and low supply. One-bedroom apartments in the city centre command premium rents. Tenancies are typically secured through online portals, and a security deposit plus first month's rent is standard at move-in.

banking.summary: Opening a current account in Dublin generally requires photo ID and proof of an Irish address; a PPS number is often requested. Digital banks are widely used by newcomers as they can be opened quickly before local address documents are available.
required_docs: Proof of Irish address (utility bill or lease)

schools.summary: Dublin offers state-funded primary and secondary schools following the Irish national curriculum, alongside a number of private and international schools. Non-Irish curricula are available at international schools serving the expatriate community.
curricula: Irish national curriculum (Junior Cycle / Leaving Certificate)

legal_admin.summary: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens may live and work in Ireland without registration. Non-EEA nationals staying more than 90 days must register their immigration permission and obtain an Irish Residence Permit (IRP).
legal_admin.registration_step: Non-EEA nationals register their immigration permission and obtain an Irish Residence Permit (IRP) through the Immigration Service.

tax_finance.summary: Anyone starting work or accessing public services in Ireland needs a Personal Public Service (PPS) number. Income tax and social contributions are administered through the national revenue authority under the PAYE system.

transport.summary: Dublin's public transport is coordinated under Transport for Ireland and includes Dublin Bus, the Luas tram network, and the DART/commuter rail. Fares are paid with the contactless Leap Card, which offers capped and discounted travel.
transport.network_name: Transport for Ireland (TFI) — Dublin Bus, Luas, DART
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA driving licences are fully recognised and can be exchanged; other licences may require exchange via the National Driver Licence Service (NDLS) depending on the issuing country.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a local GP; a PPS number is needed to apply for a medical card or GP visit card through the Health Service Executive (HSE).
